headline: Mooring and Weathered Fronts Intensify
war_summary: Since the last edition, WeatheredExpanseHex has become the sharpest-moving front, reporting six base events in the latest two hours and 34 across the day, while casualty and enlistment rates continue to accelerate. MooringCountyHex has likewise quickened, rising to 32 daily events and seven in two hours; its twelve bases remain divided, nine Warden and three Colonial. StlicanShelfHex has expanded to ten daily events, including three in the latest two hours, with three Warden, five Colonial, and one neutral base. FarranacCoastHex has cooled from its earlier burst, showing no events in two hours and seven in twenty-four, though activity remains evident in the six-hour figures. StonecradleHex still records seventeen daily events, but its latest reported turnover came several hours ago; ownership stands at eight Colonial bases and one Warden. CallahansPassageHex has no logged base changes despite the heaviest sustained combat figures among the quiet sectors, with casualty and enlistment rates accelerating sharply. Most other regions show little or no recorded base movement.
